howto.name: Upload up to 100 PDFs
howto.text: Drag up to 100 PDF files, 500 MB in total. They are uploaded together, and the server reads each file's page count without rendering any pages, so the counts come back quickly once the upload finishes.

howto.name: Read the per-file count
howto.text: Each filename appears with its page count, and the total across all files appears above the list — ideal for print quotes. Files that cannot be read are marked invalid and left out of the total.

faq.q: How is this faster than opening each PDF?
faq.a: You drop all the files at once instead of opening them one by one, and the server reads each page count without rendering any pages, so once the upload finishes the counts come back quickly.

faq.q: Does it work on encrypted PDFs?
faq.a: Often. Files that only restrict printing or editing are counted normally, and some files that need a password to open are counted too. When a password-protected file keeps its page list encrypted, though, it shows 0 pages, so remove the password with Unlock PDF first. Files the tool cannot read at all are marked invalid.
Yes. Add every file in a print job to get each file's page count and the combined total in one go, which is what a per-page quote needs.
